description: Asking to trace the path to a host maps to network/trace_route, not ping_host (which only reports reachable / not) or dns_lookup. Uses 8.8.8.8 so the trace needs only outbound probes; the op is bounded by its own hop cap and context deadline.
prompt: Trace the network route to 8.8.8.8 and show me each hop.

description: Asking who owns a domain maps to network/whois_lookup, not dns_lookup (which only resolves the name to an IP). Uses example.com, a reserved documentation domain, so no real third party is queried about.
prompt: Who owns the domain example.com and when does it expire?

description: Asking to see the routing table maps to network/route_table (kernel routes), distinct from current_network (just the default route + this Mac's address). Read-only, fixed argv, no external dependency.
prompt: Show me my Mac's kernel routing table.

description: Asking to flush the DNS cache maps to network/flush_dns_cache. It is an auto-commit mutation (benign: the cache repopulates on demand), so calling the network tool runs it immediately and succeeds without a stage/execute round trip.
